title: ASHA workers to begin round-the-clock dharna on Nov 17

ai.summary: ASHA workers plan indefinite round-the-clock dharna starting Nov 17 in Bengaluru seeking Rs 15,000 monthly honorarium and other demands, after receiving only Rs 8,000 for nine years.

facts.claim: ASHA workers will begin an indefinite round-the-clock dharna at Freedom Park in Bengaluru on Nov 17
facts.quote: ASHA workers will begin an indefinite round-the-clock dharna at Freedom Park in Bengaluru on Nov 17

facts.claim: seeking a fixed monthly honorarium of Rs 15,000 and fulfilment of other demands
facts.quote: seeking a fixed monthly honorarium of Rs 15,000 and fulfilment of other demands

facts.claim: the state’s ASHA workers received Rs 8,000 a month and their honorarium had increased by only Rs 1,500 in nine years
facts.quote: the state’s ASHA workers received Rs 8,000 a month and their honorarium had increased by only Rs 1,500 in nine years

facts.claim: Workers in Kerala, Maharashtra, West Bengal and Haryana received Rs 12,000
facts.quote: Workers in Kerala, Maharashtra, West Bengal and Haryana received Rs 12,000

facts.claim: repeated protests had led to assurances from state govt, but the demands remained unfulfilled
facts.quote: repeated protests had led to assurances from state govt, but the demands remained unfulfilled

facts.claim: the state had about 30,000 ASHA workers
facts.quote: the state had about 30,000 ASHA workers

facts.claim: About 15,000 would join the protest daily by district-wise rotation
facts.quote: About 15,000 would join the protest daily by district-wise rotation

facts.claim: All workers would remain off duty indefinitely from Nov 17
facts.quote: All workers would remain off duty indefinitely from Nov 17

ai.background_note: ASHA workers are community health workers in India who receive government payments for health services. They have been a key part of India's public health system since the 2010s.
